scope: Early startup isolation only; no firmware, full-board or clock-phase qualification
interpretation: Fixed analog driver controls complete 150 us without bridges, with ADC observers, and with ADC observers plus constant known-low DAC inputs. The no-bridge clock peak remains below the 2 V high-level requirement in this early window. Static ADC/DAC presence does not reproduce the live startup abort under these fixed controls; changing output events and feedback remain to be isolated.
